done_when: One close after accepting findings runs the checks and reports Ready, or stops and names the failing check.

known.title: Gate: acceptance names a failing CI check
Gate: verify the accepted item is actually ready

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - CI fails after the owner accepts the remaining findings.
The acceptance cases always report the `tests` check as successful and never assert that a red CI check stops close and names the check. `tests/test_close_runs_tests_and_review_together.py:210` covers failed local tests after acceptance, while `tests/test_close.py:321` covers red CI on an ordinary close. A regression that ignores a red CI result only during acceptance would pass both. Extend the acceptance command test with a failing CI check and assert the failure name and absence of Ready.
findings.title: Gate: acceptance names a failing CI check

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - CI passes after acceptance and the agent proceeds to merge the item.
The new assertion reads a private receipt and checks only its commit. A CI acceptance that wrote the current commit with a missing or blocked review value would still pass this test, but `src/forge/merge.py:72` requires a clean review before merging. The assertion also breaks if readiness is stored differently without changing behavior. Verify readiness through a Forge command or board boundary instead.
findings.title: Gate: verify the accepted item is actually ready

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - CI runs the new default-moves case.
The standard says: "Tests build their own data with factories, own that data, don't depend on order, and never sleep." This call uses `tests/test_reviewchoice_skip.py:86` to leave a check in progress with a ten-second wait; `src/forge/checks.py:148` then sleeps before polling again. The added case therefore incurs a fixed wait on each run. Use the existing fake clock to advance the poll without waiting.
findings.title: Standard: Tests never sleep

why: After the owner accepts the remaining review findings, the first close prints a clean review but the item is not Ready, so the owner has to run close a second time.
